name: Exceptional Mount
body:
When you choose an animal to serve as your mount, you know what to look for.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 7 ranks, Mounted Combat, Ride by Attack

Benefit(s): By spending 24 hours with a normal animal that could bear you as a rider, you are able to draw out its potential. Choose an animal that could serve as your mount and spend 24 hours with it bonding and training and you may treat the animal as an animal companion as the druid class feature, using your character level -4 to determine your effective druid level. The animal chosen must be perfectly ordinary prior to the bond formed with this feat. This cannot allow you to have multiple animal companions.
